attributes.title: Level 3

subgroups.name: Discover

steps.text: Watch this video to learn about using conditionals in your projects to run a chunk of code based on whether or not certain conditions are true!

questions.hint: What does a conditional do in a computer program?
questions.title: [Select one] What is a conditional?

answers.text: Code that causes a program to make a decision.
The act of cleaning up your code.
Something to keep your sprites cool in hot weather.
Code that will run no matter what actions have happened or not happened.

questions.correctResponse: Conditionals present different options or paths for your program.

steps.text: Watch this video to learn more about using conditionals in your projects to run a chunk of code based on whether or not certain conditions are true!

questions.hint: Will a conditional’s code run if the condition is false?
questions.title: [Select one] The code within a conditional will only run if the stated condition, or situation, is true.
questions.correctResponse: Conditionals tell a program, “You can do this, but on this condition!”

questions.hint: Would the user win the game if they scored fewer than the goal number of points?
questions.title: [Select one] A program uses a conditional that runs [game over win] if the score = 10. What happens if the score is 9?
questions.correctResponse: If a condition is not true, the program continues running but skips over the code in the conditional.

questions.hint: What should happen if the number is greater than 5? What should happen if the number is less than 5?
questions.title: [Match one per answer] If the number is greater than (>) 5, then high five. Else, snap.
questions.correctResponse: Remember a conditional reads: if this condition is true, do this action.  Else, do this action instead.

attributes.description: You’ve reached Level 3 of Yellow Belt! In this level, you’ll learn about conditionals, which are code that makes a decision in a program. Here are the achievements you’ll unlock in Level 3:

badges.title: What if?
badges.description: Use conditionals to make different things happen in a project.

badges.title: To Be or Not to Be?
What are the Chances?
badges.description: Use probability in a conditional statement.

badges.title: Same Difference
badges.description: Compare two values in a conditional statement.

badges.title: Coming from Left Field
badges.description: Launch a projectile from the side of the screen.

badges.title: Weighing the Options
badges.description: Use an if/else statement in a project.
